This individual contributor role combines bioinformatics, machine learning, and software engineering to turn genomic, multi-omics, imaging, and clinical data into reliable, traceable scientific capabilities. The engineer will develop and evaluate biological foundation-model applications and supporting platforms, working closely with computational biologists, data engineers, translational scientists, and clinical teams. Key responsibilities Design, develop, validate, and operate foundation-model-enabled applications for genomics, transcriptomics, single-cell and spatial omics, proteomics, imaging, and clinical data. Adapt and evaluate biological foundation models, protein and sequence models, multimodal models, and large language models for biomarker discovery, target identification, patient stratification, and scientific decision support. Build robust model development workflows spanning data curation, representation learning, fine-tuning or parameter-efficient adaptation, retrieval augmentation, evaluation, and monitored deployment. Engineer scalable, reproducible pipelines for preparing and harmonizing multi-omics and clinical datasets, with clear provenance, versioning, quality controls, and fit-for-purpose access controls. Develop agentic workflows that combine foundation models with validated bioinformatics tools, structured knowledge, and human review to support research planning, quality control, analysis execution, and result interpretation. Define rigorous benchmarking and validation strategies, including biological relevance, robustness, bias assessment, uncertainty, hallucination risk, and reproducibility for models and AI-enabled workflows. Partner on real world data projects and establish utility for precision medicine applications Partner with computational biology, wet-lab, clinical, data engineering, and product teams to translate scientific needs into usable, well-documented technical solutions. Develop production-ready services and interfaces using cloud and GPU infrastructure; optimize performance, cost, reliability, and observability for large-scale data and model workloads. Produce clear technical documentation, model cards, evaluation reports, and methods descriptions suitable for internal review, regulated development contexts, and scientific publication. Troubleshoot end-to-end platform and pipeline issues, promote engineering best practices, and contribute to a culture of scientific rigor and responsible AI use. Required qualifications Education & experience Master’s or PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Genetics/Genomics, or a related discipline. 7+ years of hands-on experience building bioinformatics, machine learning, data science, or research software solutions; experience applying AI to biomedical or life-science data is strongly preferred. Technical skills Strong programming skills in Python and practical experience with software engineering practices, including Git, testing, code review, CI/CD, and documentation. Hands-on expertise with deep learning and foundation models, including transformers, self-supervised learning, embedding models, fine-tuning or parameter-efficient adaptation, evaluation, and inference optimization. Experience using or adapting biological foundation models for sequence, protein, cellular, molecular, or multimodal biomedical data; familiarity with LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, and tool-using agents. Experience with Hugging Face and AWS Sagemaker. Strong understanding of genomics, transcriptomics, single-cell or spatial omics, proteomics, imaging, or other biomedical data modalities and their analytical limitations. Experience designing reproducible data and analysis workflows using workflow engines such as Nextflow or Snakemake and containers such as Docker or Singularity. Experience with cloud and HPC environments, GPU compute, distributed training or inference, and scalable data processing frameworks. Working knowledge of biological data formats and standards, including FASTQ, BAM/CRAM, VCF/MAF, HDF5, AnnData, Seurat, and metadata best practices. Experience curating, integrating, and governing data from public biological and clinical resources such as TCGA, GTEx, GEO, SRA, dbGaP, cBioPortal, ClinVar, CellxGene, COSMIC, gnomAD, and UniProt. Ability to design scientifically meaningful benchmarks and communicate model performance, limitations, uncertainty, and responsible-use guidance to technical and scientific stakeholders. Strong statistical reasoning and experience applying quality control and appropriate evaluation methods to biological data and machine learning systems. Experience in a biomedical, pharmaceutical, or regulated research environment is preferred. .

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
We are seeking a Strategic Finance Lead to provide finance leadership for our accelerator investments. In this role, you will be a key partner to our compute teams, providing financial expertise and guidance to optimize our compute investments and drive strategic decision-making.
In this role, you’ll develop deep expertise in the economics of AI compute, from the unit economics of individual training runs to the long-range financial planning of our accelerator fleet. You’ll build financial models that inform Anthropic’s investment decisions, own planning and forecasting processes for major cost centers, and translate complex technical dynamics into clear financial narratives for leadership.
This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives at the intersection of finance and technology, and who is energized by building frameworks from scratch in a fast-moving environment.
Key responsibilities
Finance lead for cloud accelerator compute spend, including budgeting, monthly forecasting, variance analysis, and financial plan maintenance
Build and maintain detailed bottoms-up data-driven financial models for accelerator infrastructure, including long-range forecasts, cost driver analyses, and investment scenario modeling
Develop deep expertise in compute contracts, pricing structures, and cost drivers, and surface optimization opportunities across our infrastructure
Serve as subject matter expert for Anthropic’s overall compute capacity plan, owning source of truth and plan of record
Support the implementation and management of financial planning tools (e.g., Pigment), ensuring our models and processes scale with the organization
Analyze the economics of model training and research compute, including ROI across different dimensions like training run sizes, chip types, data, etc, and distill into actionable framework for capacity planning and deployment
Partner closely with engineering and research teams to understand how training and reinforcement learning processes scale, and translate those technical dynamics into financial frameworks
You may be a good fit if you have:
Exceptional analytical skills with an ability to synthesize data into compelling insights and develop complex financial operating models
Extraordinary problem-solving and critical thinking abilities to come up with new frameworks for assessing profitability and capital efficiency in a rapidly evolving industry
Attention to detail and patience for getting to the source of truth on complex and interconnected underlying financial and legal frameworks
Comfort working cross-functionally and are adept at communicating complex financial information to non-finance audiences
Proven track record of partnering with technical teams to drive financial optimization initiatives
Excitement about working collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt well to change
Possess a bias towards action, strong work ethic, and have experience driving operational outcomes under tight timelines
Strong relationship building, business judgment, process management, and communication skills
Are passionate about Anthropic's mission to build safe, transformative AI systems
Are passionate about the effective integration of AI tools to streamline manual finance workflows
Background in AI, ML, or high-performance, large-scale computing infrastructure, including data centers, cloud service providers, etc
Preferred qualifications
7+ years of experience in strategic finance, infrastructure investment, private equity, growth equity, consulting, or investment banking, preferably with infrastructure, datacenter, or technology infrastructure experience
3+ years of experience specifically in cloud infrastructure financial management
Experience working directly with major cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure)
MBA or other advanced degree in finance, economics, or business
Deep expertise in cloud service provider economics, contract structures, and pricing models
Experience with chip architecture economics and optimization strategies

Your safety matters to us.

About the Role
Coupang is seeking a Product Manager to join the International Transportation Product team, responsible for building and scaling technology products that power our end-to-end transportation network across Asia.
This role owns products spanning the entire transportation journey, from supplier pickup and fulfillment center movement to last-mile delivery and returns. You will work closely with operations, engineering, and data teams to develop innovative products that improve efficiency, reliability, and customer experience.
This is not a Taiwan-only role. The successful candidate will have opportunities to drive transportation technology initiatives with global impact, including our strategic address intelligence platform and next-generation delivery applications across multiple markets.
What You Will Do
Product Ownership
Own and manage products across the full transportation lifecycle:
First Mile (Supplier → Fulfillment Center)
Middle Mile (Fulfillment Center → Delivery Station)
Last Mile (Delivery Station → Customer / Returns)
Define product strategy, roadmap, and requirements based on business needs and operational challenges.
Write detailed product requirements and work closely with engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.
Partner with operations teams to identify opportunities for automation, efficiency improvement, and service enhancement.
Transportation Technology Innovation
Lead the development of transportation technology products that improve network efficiency and delivery performance.
Drive adoption of new products through User Acceptance Testing (UAT), pilot programs, and large-scale rollout across the network.
Develop AI-powered solutions to enhance delivery quality, compliance, and operational excellence.
Address Intelligence Platform
Contribute to the development of Coupang's proprietary address intelligence platform.
Build products that leverage delivery insights collected across millions of customer interactions and thousands of drivers.
Help create scalable infrastructure that improves address accuracy, route efficiency, and delivery success rates across markets.
Delivery App Experience
Drive enhancements to the delivery applications used by drivers.
Work on innovative capabilities including:
Real-time delivery photo verification
Location compliance validation
Image intelligence and automation
AI-powered operational tools
Cross-Functional Leadership
Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Data Analytics, and Business stakeholders.
Make data-driven product decisions through metrics analysis and experimentation.
Influence transportation technology strategy across Taiwan and other international markets.
Basic Qualifications
8+ years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience.
Proven experience managing products from concept through launch and adoption.
Strong experience writing product requirements and working closely with engineering teams.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Fluent English & Chinese communication skills (written and verbal).
Currently based in Taiwan
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in Transportation, Logistics, Mobility, Ride-Hailing, Delivery, or Supply Chain industries.
Software Engineering background, especially candidates who transitioned from SDE to Product Management.
Experience building data-intensive or platform products.
Experience working with AI, machine learning, or operational technology products.
Experience working across multiple countries or global teams.
Why Join Us?
Build transportation products with global impact.
Own mission-critical systems supporting one of the fastest-growing eCommerce networks in Asia.
Work on cutting-edge AI applications in logistics and delivery.
Influence product strategy across multiple markets, including Taiwan, Korea, and future expansion markets.
Partner with highly collaborative teams spanning Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations.

Company Introduction
About Rocket Now
Rocket Now is a food delivery service with no delivery or service fees. Consumers can enjoy a wide variety of cuisines, from Japanese and Western food to healthy options, as well as desserts and drinks, quickly and affordably. The service is currently available mainly in Hokkaido, Tohoku (Sendai), Kanto (Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama, Chiba), Chubu (Aichi, Shizuoka), Kansai (Osaka, Kyoto, Hyogo), Hiroshima, and Kyushu (Fukuoka).
Rocket Now won the Excellence Award in the Shopping Category at the Best App Awards 2025. Furthermore, it has achieved the No. 1 ranking in the Food Delivery App category for nine consecutive months on both the iOS and Android app stores (*1), and the app continues to grow, surpassing 5 million downloads in just 15 months since its launch (*2).
*1 Based on integrated iOS and Android data from July 2025 to March 2026. *2 As of January 14, 2025, service release date (Source: Global Market Intelligence: Sensor Tower)
About CP One Japan
CP One Japan LLC is the Japanese subsidiary of Coupang, Inc. (NYSE: CPNG), a US-based company listed on the NYSE (New York Stock Exchange) and one of the Fortune 150 companies, known as a technology company. CP One Japan operates the "Rocket Now" brand food delivery service in Japan, leveraging Coupang's technological capabilities and innovative logistics solutions to provide fast, reliable, and customer-oriented food delivery services to Japanese consumers.
Role Overview
As a Senior Regional Merchant Operations Manager, you are a master problem-solver who defines operational bottlenecks, designs scalable frameworks, and drives regional strategic initiatives. You will bridge high-level strategy with local execution, establishing robust SOPs and data-driven solutions to optimize merchant fulfillment and drive sustainable GMV expansion.
What You Will Do
Merchant Operations & Operational Excellence
Fulfillment Optimization
: Diagnose and elevate operational metrics (Open Rate, Order Acceptance Rate, Downtime, Schedule Hours) through data-driven workflow improvements.
Kitchen & Workflow Advisory
: Consult directly with restaurant partners on packaging standards, kitchen dispatch workflows, and POS system integrations to maximize throughput.
Live Incident Management:
Act as the primary escalation point for critical live-order failures, store outages, and food/packaging quality complaints.
Root-Cause Bottleneck Resolution:
Define, analyze, and solve complex operational inefficiencies across open rates, downtime, and acceptance metrics by designing systemic solutions.
Workflow Integration:
Standardize kitchen dispatch and POS integration frameworks for enterprise and multi-chain restaurant partners.
Merchant Growth
Onboarding & Activation:
Streamline merchant onboarding to accelerate time-to-first-order and maintain store retention.
Revenue & GMV Execution:
Partner with key accounts to analyze sales data and execute menu, pricing, and promotional optimizations to drive revenue.
Growth Strategy Formulation:
Leverage advanced sales analytics to build scalable menu architecture, pricing models, and regional promotional strategies.
Retention & Funnel Optimization:
Architect the end-to-end merchant onboarding journey to systematically eliminate churn points and maximize partner lifetime value.
People Leadership & Process Building
Team Empowerment:
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of operations managers and specialists, fostering a problem-solving culture.
SOP Architecture:
Establish and continuously refine regional Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for onboarding, menu management, and emergency response.
Basic Qualifications
8+years total work experience
5+ years in Food Delivery, Quick-Commerce, On-Demand Delivery, or F&B Retail Operations.
5+ years of direct team management experience with a track record of driving operational problem-solving.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in English and Japanese.
Familiarity with Salesforce, Tableau, or SQL to analyze operational data.
Preferred Qualifications
Advanced analytical mindset with proven experience using BI tools (Tableau, PowerBI, SQL) or CRM (Salesforce) to translate raw data into actionable strategies.
Strong understanding of restaurant POS integrations, kitchen workflows, and last-mile delivery dynamics.
Background in management consulting, strategic operations, or fast-scaling tech startups.

Maintain records of inspections Collaborate with replenishment lead on dumps, damages and produce re-work decisions Communicate daily with the replenishment lead and warehouse manager on all issues related to fresh produce.
